q.en: What is a game's "core loop"?
q.zh: 什么是游戏的「核心循环 (core loop)」？

options.en: The short repeating sequence of actions a player does most of the time
options.zh: 玩家绝大部分时间反复执行的那段短动作序列

options.en: The opening cutscene that plays once
options.zh: 只在开场播一次的过场动画

explain.en: Core loop = the do-it-again unit (aim→shoot→reward→repeat). Everything else wraps around it.
explain.zh: 核心循环就是"再来一次"的最小单元，其余系统都包在它外面。

q.en: A new player should ideally understand a scroll-feed mini-game within roughly…
q.zh: 在信息流里刷到的小游戏，新玩家理想情况下应在大约多久内看懂？

options.en: A couple of seconds, with no tutorial

explain.en: Zero-context, near-zero patience: self-explanatory UI beats explanatory text.
explain.zh: 零上下文、近乎零耐心，自解释的 UI 胜过解释性文案。

q.en: Which reward schedule tends to be the most engaging (and habit-forming)?
q.zh: 哪种奖励节奏通常最能吸引人（也最易养成习惯）？

options.zh: 每个动作都给固定奖励

options.en: One reward only at the very end
options.zh: 只在最末尾给一次奖励

explain.en: Variable ratio reinforcement is the strongest driver of repeat behavior.
explain.zh: 可变比率强化是重复行为最强的驱动力。

q.en: "Difficulty curve" problems most often show up as…
q.zh: 「难度曲线」问题最常表现为……

options.en: A sudden spike or a flat boring stretch
options.zh: 突然的陡峰，或一段平坦无聊的区间

explain.en: Good pacing ramps challenge smoothly; spikes frustrate, flats bore.
explain.zh: 好的节奏让难度平滑爬升；陡峰让人挫败，平坦让人无聊。

q.en: "Game feel" / "juice" mainly refers to…
q.zh: 「手感 / juice」主要指……

options.en: The immediate sensory feedback that makes actions feel satisfying
options.zh: 让动作"爽"的即时感官反馈

options.en: The size of the dev team

explain.en: Juice = the layer of feedback (shake, particles, sound) on top of mechanics.
explain.zh: juice 是叠在机制之上的反馈层（震屏、粒子、音效）。

q.en: "Flow state" is best sustained when challenge is…
q.zh: 当难度处于什么状态时，最能维持「心流 (flow)」？

options.en: Balanced just above the player's current skill
options.zh: 略高于玩家当前技能、保持平衡

explain.en: Too hard → anxiety, too easy → boredom; flow sits in between.
explain.zh: 太难→焦虑，太易→无聊，心流在两者之间。

q.en: The best way to teach a game's first mechanic is usually…
q.zh: 教会玩家游戏第一个机制，通常最好的方式是……

options.en: Let them do it once in a safe, guided moment (learning by doing)
options.zh: 在安全、被引导的瞬间让他们先做一次（做中学）

options.en: Show a long text tutorial first

options.zh: 让他们看 2 分钟视频

options.en: Hide it and hope they discover it
options.zh: 藏起来，指望他们自己发现

explain.en: Learning by doing beats reading; a guided first success teaches fastest.
explain.zh: 做中学胜过阅读，一次被引导的成功最快教会人。

q.en: Win and lose states in a game should be…
q.zh: 游戏的胜利/失败状态应当……

options.en: Immediately clear and unambiguous to the player
options.zh: 对玩家即时、清晰、无歧义

explain.en: Players must always know if they're winning or losing — feedback drives action.
explain.zh: 玩家必须随时知道自己是赢是输——反馈驱动行动。

q.en: An "affordance" in UI design is…
q.zh: UI 设计中的「可供性 (affordance)」是指……

options.en: A property that suggests how an element can be used
options.zh: 暗示元素该如何被使用的属性

explain.en: A button that looks pressable affords pressing. Signifiers make affordances visible.
explain.zh: 看起来能按的按钮就"可供"按压；signifier 让可供性可见。

q.en: Fitts's Law implies that a tap target should be…
q.zh: Fitts 定律意味着点击目标应当……

options.en: Bigger and/or closer to be faster to hit
options.zh: 更大、更近，从而更快命中

options.en: The same color as the background

explain.en: Time to target ∝ distance / size. Big, near targets are fast.
explain.zh: 命中时间正比于距离/尺寸，大而近的目标更快。

q.en: Hick's Law suggests that adding more options to a menu…
q.zh: Hick 定律表明，给菜单增加更多选项会……

options.en: Has no effect on decision time

explain.en: Decision time grows with the number of choices — fewer, clearer options win.
explain.zh: 决策时间随选项数量增长——更少更清晰的选项更优。

q.en: On touch screens, a comfortable minimum tap-target size is roughly…
q.zh: 触屏上，舒适的最小点击目标尺寸大约是……

explain.en: ~44pt/48dp is the common floor so fingers don't mis-tap.
explain.zh: 约 44pt/48dp 是常见下限，避免手指误触。

q.en: Roughly how long can UI feedback be delayed before it stops feeling "instant"?
q.zh: UI 反馈延迟大约超过多少，就不再感觉是「即时」的？

explain.en: ~0.1s feels instant; ~1s keeps flow; >10s loses attention.
explain.zh: 约 0.1 秒感觉即时，约 1 秒维持心流，超 10 秒注意力流失。

q.en: Jakob's Law states that users…
q.zh: Jakob 定律指出，用户……

options.en: Expect your product to work like the other products they already know
options.zh: 期望你的产品像他们已熟悉的其他产品一样运作
总是偏好全新的交互模式
想要最大程度的自定义

explain.en: Lean on familiar conventions; novelty for its own sake costs usability.
explain.zh: 借力熟悉的约定，为新而新会牺牲可用性。

q.en: A good error message should mainly…
q.zh: 一条好的错误提示主要应当……

options.en: Explain what happened and how to recover
options.zh: 说明发生了什么以及如何恢复

options.en: Show a raw error code only
options.zh: 只显示一串原始错误码

explain.en: Errors should be clear, blameless, and recoverable.
explain.zh: 错误提示应清晰、不指责、可恢复。

q.en: "Easing" in animation refers to…
q.zh: 动画里的「缓动 (easing)」是指……

options.en: Varying speed over time instead of moving linearly
options.zh: 速度随时间变化，而非匀速直线运动

explain.en: Ease-in/out makes motion feel natural; linear feels robotic.
explain.zh: 缓入缓出让运动自然，匀速显得机械。

q.en: "Screenshake" is mainly used to…
q.zh: 「震屏 (screenshake)」主要用来……

explain.en: A few frames of shake on impact sells weight and force.
explain.zh: 命中瞬间几帧抖动能传达重量与力量。

q.en: Anticipation and follow-through (12 animation principles) help by…
q.zh: 预备动作与跟随动作（动画 12 原则）的作用是……

options.en: Making motion read clearly and feel weighty

explain.en: A small wind-up + overshoot makes actions legible and alive.
explain.zh: 小幅蓄力+回弹让动作清晰且有生命力。

q.en: When should you give immediate audio/visual feedback for a tap?
q.zh: 点击操作的音/画反馈应在何时给出？

options.en: On the press, before the result resolves
options.zh: 在按下那一刻，先于结果产生

options.en: Only at the end of the session

explain.en: Instant feedback on press confirms the input even if the result lags.
explain.zh: 按下即反馈，即使结果有延迟也先确认了输入。

q.en: "Hit-stop" (a brief freeze on impact) is used to…
q.zh: 「顿帧 (hit-stop)」（命中瞬间短暂定格）用来……

options.en: Emphasize the weight and impact of a hit
options.zh: 强调一次命中的重量与冲击

options.en: Skip a frame to run faster

explain.en: A few frames of freeze on impact makes hits feel powerful.
explain.zh: 命中时定格几帧，让打击感更有力量。

q.en: Particle effects in games primarily serve to…
q.zh: 游戏里的粒子特效主要用来……

options.en: Reinforce feedback and make events feel alive
options.zh: 强化反馈、让事件更有生命力

options.en: Increase the download size on purpose

explain.en: Particles are feedback garnish — they amplify, they aren't the dish.
explain.zh: 粒子是反馈的点缀——用来放大，而非主菜。

q.en: Designing for a vertical scroll-feed, you should assume the user…
q.zh: 为竖向信息流设计时，应假设用户……

options.en: Arrives with zero context and almost no patience
options.zh: 带着零上下文、近乎零耐心进来

options.en: Wants to configure settings before playing

explain.en: No rules to learn, no choices before play, instant feedback.
explain.zh: 没有要学的规则，玩前不做选择，即点即有反馈。

q.en: A "self-explanatory UI" means…
q.zh: 「自解释的 UI」意味着……

options.en: The interface teaches itself through visuals, not text walls
options.zh: 界面靠视觉自我教学，而非大段文案

options.en: It comes with a long PDF manual
options.zh: 配一份长 PDF 手册

options.en: It only works for returning users

explain.en: Show, don't tell — affordances over instructions.
explain.zh: 用展示代替讲解，可供性优于说明文字。

q.en: For a feed mini-game, designing for "one-shot" play rather than retention means…
q.zh: 为信息流小游戏做「一次性」而非「留存」设计，意味着……

options.en: The first encounter must be complete and satisfying on its own
options.zh: 第一次相遇本身就要完整且满足

explain.en: Assume no return visit; make the single session pay off.
explain.zh: 别假设回访，让单局本身就值回票价。

q.en: On a large phone held one-handed, the easiest area for the thumb to reach is…
q.zh: 单手握持大屏手机时，拇指最易触达的区域是……

explain.en: Put primary actions in the thumb zone (bottom), not the top corners.
explain.zh: 把主要操作放在拇指区（底部），别放顶角。

q.en: Which of these make a feed mini-game graspable in seconds? (Select all)
q.zh: 以下哪些能让信息流小游戏在几秒内被看懂？（多选）

options.en: No rules to learn before playing
Instant feedback on the first tap
options.zh: 第一次点击就有即时反馈
先来一个强制设置步骤

explain.en: The first three reduce time-to-understand; settings and signup add friction before the fun.
explain.zh: 前三项缩短理解时间，设置和注册在乐趣前增加摩擦。

q.en: In a UGC social game, "a feed needs a verb" means…
q.zh: UGC 社交游戏里「feed needs a verb（信息流需要一个动词）」是指……

options.en: Viewers need an action to take on content, which notifies the author
options.zh: 观众需要一个能对内容施加的动作，且会通知作者

options.en: Every post must contain a verb in its title
options.zh: 每条内容标题里必须含动词

explain.en: A passive feed dies; a verb (kept/popped/remixed) creates a loop back to the author.
explain.zh: 纯被动的 feed 会死，一个动词会把价值回流给作者，形成循环。

q.en: A healthy social notification (e.g. "X reacted to your work") should…
q.zh: 一条健康的社交通知（如「X 对你的作品有反应」）应当……

options.en: Be triggered by another real user acting on your content, with self-guard & dedupe
options.zh: 由其他真实用户对你的内容操作触发，并做自我屏蔽与去重

options.en: Be sent to yourself for your own actions
options.zh: 因你自己的操作而发给自己

options.en: Repeat every minute regardless of activity
options.zh: 不论是否有活动每分钟重复

explain.en: Notify on others' actions; never self-notify; never fake users.
explain.zh: 因他人操作而通知，不自我通知，不用假用户。

q.en: For a social game's cold-start (no real users yet), the best fallback is…
q.zh: 社交游戏冷启动（还没有真实用户）时，最佳兜底是……

options.en: A real subject that needs no fake identity (e.g. "you vs. your AI self")
options.zh: 不需要假身份的真实主体（如「你 vs 你的 AI 分身」）
自动生成的假用户资料
抄另一个 app 的用户列表

explain.en: Fake users are dead-ends that expose the fake; use a real, safe subject.
explain.zh: 假用户是会暴露的死路，用真实、安全的主体兜底。

q.en: "Virality" in a product loop usually comes from…
q.zh: 产品循环里的「病毒性」通常来自……

options.en: Each user's action naturally surfacing the product to new users
options.zh: 每个用户的行为自然把产品带到新用户面前

explain.en: Built-in sharing as a side effect of normal use beats paid acquisition.
explain.zh: 把分享内建为正常使用的副产品，胜过付费获取。

q.en: A "leaderboard rivalry" notification (e.g. "X just beat your score") works because it…
q.zh: 「排行榜对手」通知（如「X 刚超过了你的分数」）有效，是因为它……

options.en: Gives the beaten player a reason to come back and reclaim their spot
options.zh: 给被超过的玩家一个回来夺回名次的理由

explain.en: Competition + a personal stake pulls the rival back into the loop.
explain.zh: 竞争+切身利害把对手重新拉回循环。

q.en: Retention and virality differ in that…
q.zh: 留存与病毒性的区别在于……

options.en: Retention brings the same users back; virality brings new users in
options.zh: 留存让同一批用户回来，病毒性带来新用户

options.en: They mean exactly the same thing
Virality only matters for paid ads
options.zh: 病毒性只对付费广告有意义

options.en: Retention only matters on launch day
options.zh: 留存只在上线当天有意义

explain.en: Different loops: retention = come-back, virality = bring-a-friend.
explain.zh: 两套循环：留存=回来，病毒性=带朋友来。
